used_propositions: CRM record HEL-441 names the counterparty as Helion Robotics Ltd.
Registry record 11847299 names the entity as HELION INDUSTRIAL SYSTEMS LTD.
Helion Industrial Systems Ltd is a different company.
Helion Industrial Systems Ltd sold sensors in 2018 and has no current MSA.
support_claim: CRM HEL-441 names Helion Robotics Ltd while registry 11847299 names Helion Industrial Systems Ltd, and commercial notes explicitly establish Helion Industrial Systems Ltd as a separate company from the Helion Robotics CRM counterparty.
